reviews.evidence: Shipped Windows workbench spans AI coding, files/Git, task automation, plugins, remote/SSH/mobile access, with many real UI screenshots and explicit repair, rollback, test-matrix, privacy, and compatibility evidence.
reviews.concern: Most workflows are described at feature level rather than worked end to end, while deeper upgrade and recovery procedures are delegated to linked documents.

reviews.evidence: Provides project/conversation binding, dockable file-terminal-browser panes, artifact auto-mounting, and a live control room; quick start, alternate installs, screenshots, strict regression probes, recovery cases, limits, and privacy behavior are concrete.
reviews.concern: Day-to-day pane and project operations are less fully documented than installation and recovery, and state remains browser-local without cross-machine sync.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive metering system covers per-session and historical costs, budgets, provider balances, subscription plans, price synchronization, alerts, and backfill, with a worked NewApi configuration, extensive real screenshots, validation commands, security controls, limits, and fallbacks.
reviews.concern: The unusually large provider and pricing surface creates operational complexity, and several estimates or integrations explicitly depend on external API stability and incomplete historical logs.

reviews.evidence: The repository visibly delivers a large category-organized ecosystem catalog, contents navigation, a generic plugin-install example, and a concise contribution path for authors.
reviews.concern: It documents little catalog-specific search, validation, update, or recovery behavior, and the generic placeholder install command is not an executable path for a selected entry.

reviews.evidence: The skill specifies adaptive one-question-at-a-time clarification, fact/assumption separation, contradiction detection, verification, and synthesis, with explicit decision-audit, deep-research, and risky-code-change scenarios plus concrete multi-agent installation compatibility.
reviews.concern: Beyond installation and trigger descriptions, it lacks a complete invocation transcript, representative clarified output, tests, limitations, or failure and recovery guidance.

reviews.evidence: Combines novel and short-drama workflows, specialized skills and roles, a three-pane editor, file following, review, and five named episode artifacts; two GIFs, pinned versions, a basic creation path, and explicit breaking-migration guidance support the claims.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance stops after choosing the main slash command, with no worked story or episode showing representative content and outcome through later stages.

reviews.evidence: An unusually complete wallpaper system ships discovery, multiple renderers, uploads, filtering, rotation, glass and font controls, persistence, power-aware pausing, and transcoding; exhaustive procedures, screenshots, measured GPU results, tests, compatibility limits, security boundaries, migrations, and layered fallbacks cover representative scenarios and outcomes.
reviews.concern: Some README sections conflict on whether state uses host configuration or localStorage and on Scene availability, so users must reconcile version-dependent behavior despite the otherwise exceptional evidence.

reviews.evidence: Ships a controllable WebGPU ocean skin through plugin, extension, static installer, or source integration, with install/update/remove flows, four parameterized GIF states, version and commit anchors, automated checks, browser acceptance tests, accessibility, privacy, and failure guidance.
reviews.concern: Demonstrations focus on visual states rather than broader outcomes, and the README does not give a consolidated WebGPU hardware and browser limitation matrix.

reviews.evidence: The catalog's own workflow spans automated discovery, read-only structural validation, generated categories, web search/filtering, in-DSH install management, anonymous API queries, contributor submission, and self-deployment, with concrete commands, limits, telemetry controls, and safety boundaries.
reviews.concern: Core website and CLI implementation lives in a sister repository, while this README shows no representative API response and little recovery guidance for deployment or installation failures.

reviews.evidence: Provides master-directory linking, app detection and import, skill installation/listing, Git push-pull synchronization, app management, and rules sync, with executable quick-start, cross-device, configuration, and language examples across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
reviews.concern: There is no actual command-output demonstration, test evidence, troubleshooting, rollback, or documented handling for link conflicts and destructive imports.
